steps.title: Join
steps.action: Join file sap.hi0256 column "persno" and file sap.currency column "pers_no".
steps.notes: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (sap.hi0256) and adds matching details from file 2 (sap.currency) when a match is found. Rows in file 2 (sap.currency) will not be kept if the keys ("persno" / "pers_no") do not match. As a result, rows from file 1 (sap.hi0256) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 2 (sap.currency).

steps.title: Join
steps.action: Join file sap.hi0256 column "workday_employee_id" and file wd.int2128s column "employee_id".
steps.notes: A FULL OUTER JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (sap.hi0256) and every record from file 2 (wd.int2128s). Matching records are combined when the keys ("workday_employee_id" / "employee_id") match. As a result, rows from either file may contain NULL values for the other file columns if no match is found.
